config.moduleName: Open AddItemMenu NG - (Open DLL for SSE - AE and VR)

plugin.name: Debug symbols (AddItemMenuSE.pdb)
plugin.description:
About 25 MB. With it, crash loggers such as Crash Logger SSE AE VR name this DLL's functions in their crash logs instead of showing bare addresses, which makes a crash report much easier to act on. Players don't need it otherwise.
The DLL itself (SKSE\Plugins\AddItemMenuSE.dll) is always installed. It replaces the one from towawot's AddItemMenu 1.14, so let this mod overwrite AddItemMenu.
